# okfs

> okfs is an open-source web file browser in one binary: run it in a folder and flip through every file with the keyboard, each one shown beside the list as the cursor lands on it.

- Platforms: Linux (x86-64 and arm64), macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows (x86-64), new. MIT license.
- One binary, 19 to 22 MB, with the page compiled in.
- Defaults: it listens on loopback only and is read only. Beyond loopback, only a link with the key that okfs prints gets in. `--qr` prints that link as a QR code for a phone.
- Search finds every name in the tree, from an index kept in memory.

## Install

- Homebrew, on macOS or Linux: `brew install jrnxf/tap/okfs`
- nix: `nix run github:jrnxf/okfs`
- Docker: `docker run -p 8080:8080 -v "$PWD:/srv:ro" ghcr.io/jrnxf/okfs:<version>`. The tag is a release's version without the `v`, such as `0.1.0-pre.26`. `latest` follows full releases only, from v0.1.0.
- From source, with a Rust toolchain and bun: `cargo install --git https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs`
- Release archives for Linux, macOS and Windows, each with a `.sha256`: https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/releases

- [Install](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/install.md): every way to get okfs, and platform notes
- [Using okfs](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/usage.md): flags, environment variables, keys, addresses, big folders
- [Network](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/network.md): the key, HTTPS, proxies, systemd and launchd
- [Writing](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/writing.md): uploading, editing, deleting and the Trash
- [Themes](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/themes.md): the built-in themes and how to write one
- [What is safe to serve](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/security.md): the security model
- [How okfs compares](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): miniserve, dufs, copyparty and `python -m http.server`
- [Develop](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/development.md): build and test
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): the 403, the 401 and a busy port, update, uninstall, the cache, browsers
- [README](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/blob/main/README.md)
- [All of the above as one file](https://okfs.jrnxf.co/llms-full.txt)
- [Live demo](https://okfs.jrnxf.co/demo/): the real okfs, compiled to WebAssembly, in the browser
- [Releases](https://github.com/jrnxf/okfs/releases)
